value.rationale: The specific numerical-method gap is that a perfectly rank-one PSD matrix flow can produce a compression error with no mean, for arbitrarily small RK steps, solely because full explicit RK endpoints leave the PSD cone. The theorem quantifies the entire integrability frontier and exact tail constant rather than merely detecting negative eigenvalues. It gives meaningful sharp RK3 and RK4 step cutoffs and non-obvious order-modulo-four behavior, while showing why tying sketches can fix an integrability obstruction in the stable phase. The comparison informs algorithm and sketch design without extrapolating to the original stage-sketched method.
